items.name: Data Scientist
items.short_description: Turns messy data into decisions using statistics, machine learning and storytelling.
items.typical_entry_education: B.Tech / B.Sc in CS, Data Science or Statistics

items.name: Biomedical Engineer
items.short_description: Designs medical devices, diagnostics and hospital technology at the meeting point of medicine and engineering.

items.name: Computational Biologist
items.short_description: Uses code and models to decode genomes, proteins and disease.

items.name: Robotics & Automation Engineer
items.short_description: Builds machines that sense, decide and act, from factory arms to farm robots.

items.name: Agri-Drone & Precision Farming Engineer
items.short_description: Applies drones, sensors and analytics to raise farm yields and cut input waste.
items.typical_entry_education: B.Tech Agricultural Engineering / B.Sc Agri + drone certification

items.name: UX / Product Designer
items.short_description: Researches users and designs digital products that are useful, usable and delightful.

items.name: Doctor (MBBS)
items.short_description: Diagnoses and treats patients; long training path with high social trust.
items.typical_entry_education: MBBS (5.5 years incl. internship) via NEET-UG
